_comment: Verified PoCs for the six FuzzBench bug benchmarks (Oct 15 2026). A PoC reproduces when the one-shot run's output contains EVERY string in `expect`; a negative control must contain none of the sanitizer markers. Checked by tools/check_fuzzbench_pocs.py.

mbedtls_fuzz_dtlsclient_7c6b0e.bug: 64-byte memory leak: mbedtls_x509_get_name() does not free its name chain on a parse error; reached from ssl_parse_certificate_request(). Fixed upstream by Mbed-TLS PR #6391.
mbedtls_fuzz_dtlsclient_7c6b0e.notes: poc_fuzzer_found.bin: queue id:001019 of online-24h-bug-mbedtls baseline trial_00 (9.31h). poc_handbuilt.bin = `python3 make_handbuilt.py neg_seed.bin out.bin 009c`.

bloaty_fuzz_target_52948c.bug: NULL dereference: CU::ReadTopLevelDIE passes a NULL abbrev to DIEReader::ReadAttributes when a .debug_info compile unit has a header and no DIE. Fixed upstream by google/bloaty f8561877e2.
bloaty_fuzz_target_52948c.notes: Hand-built: `gcc -g -gdwarf-4 -nostdlib -static -Wl,-e,f t.c`, then `objcopy --remove-section=.debug_aranges --update-section .debug_info=di.bin`. Matches FuzzBench SBFT'23 crash key Null-dereference:bloaty::dwarf::CU::ReadTopLevelDIE. Parity builds (FuzzBench UBSan, -fno-sanitize-recover=null) report it as UBSan 'member access within null pointer' at debug_info.h:360 and abort; the old bench-fb build reports an ASan SEGV at the same line. poc_fuzzer_found_r2.elf: smallest target-bug crash of online-24h-r2-bloaty (baseline trial_06, 20.1h, 3080 B).

harfbuzz_hb-shape-fuzzer_17863b.bug: Wild out-of-bounds read: OT::avar::map_coords walks `count` (coords given) instead of axisCount SegmentMaps before the avar v2 tail, so VariationStore::create_cache follows a garbage offset. Fixed upstream by harfbuzz 32c85b8c (oss-fuzz 49407).
harfbuzz_hb-shape-fuzzer_17863b.notes: Upstream ClusterFuzz minimized testcase 4523349576908800 (the id in benchmark.yaml), from the fix commit.

libxml2_xml_e85b9b.bug: Heap use-after-free in xmlXIncludeCopyXPointer: nested XIncludes free a node still in an XPath node set. Introduced by 7f04e297, fixed by its revert 938105b5.
libxml2_xml_e85b9b.notes: Smallest of 710 crashes from online-24h-bug-libxml2 (baseline trial_09).

mruby_mruby_fuzzer_8c8bbd.bug: size_t underflow in mpz_div_2exp on a bigint right shift wider than the number -> ~2^64-byte realloc (sibling: huge left shifts in mpz_mul_2exp). Fixed upstream by mruby 54fbf6c3e.
mruby_mruby_fuzzer_8c8bbd.notes: poc_clusterfuzz.rb is the input quoted in the fix commit; poc_fuzzer_found_mul2exp.rb is online-24h-bug-mruby baseline trial_01 crash id:000000 (sibling path).

php_php-fuzz-parser_0dbedb.bug: Property fetch in a constant expression skips const-expr folding (from GH-8344): NULL deref in zend_ast_evaluate_ex on [,]->e, and ZEND_ASSERT aborts on magic constants. Fixed upstream by php-src 966d22b1bda + 7b43d819c86.
php_php-fuzz-parser_0dbedb.notes: Upstream reproducers of GH-9138 and GH-9136. Parity builds (FuzzBench UBSan, -fno-sanitize-recover=null) report GH-9138 as UBSan 'member access within null pointer' at zend_ast.c:697 and abort; the old bench-fb build reports an ASan SEGV at the same line.
